comment: Day 3, fourth frozen holdout — the set the lexical-leg candidate is scored on. Sets #1, #2 and #3 are spent. Balanced like set #3 (3 cross-border, 9 across the other classes), and every file is one no earlier set touched: classify.rs, ngram_table.rs, transform.rs, linkage.rs, structsim.rs, ai/memory.rs, ai/harness.rs, machines/krisis.rs, inventory.rs, interest.rs. No `dev` split: the candidate has one free parameter and it is not tuned (RRF k is unused here; BM25's k1/b are fixed inside physis-core).
